page.layout: One printed title page, one block of text centred top to bottom; below it a woodcut diagram of concentric circles with a stamp beside it; below that the imprint centred. No margins with text.

main_text.l: In quibus ἐπισημονικῶς ostenditur, Diurnum, Annuumque Motum, qui apparet in Sole, & Cælo, non deberi Soli, aut Cælo, sed soli Terræ: simulque Adspectabilis Primi Cæli Typus, ad vivum exprimitur.

Ex Belgico Sermone in Latinum versa, à MARTINO HORTENSIO Delfensi: vna cum ipsius Præfatione, in quâ Astronomiæ Brahæanæ Fundamenta examinantur; & cum Lansbergianâ Astronomiæ Restitutione conferuntur.
Apud Zachariam Romanum, M. DC. XXX.

page.notes: Woodcut of concentric orbits with star-studded outer ring, and an oval ink stamp to its right, not transcribed. Greek word in the subtitle copied as printed; the stamp text is illegible.
